wiki.title: Melissa Provenzano
wiki.extract: Melissa Provenzano (born May 4, 1972) is an American politician who has served in the Oklahoma House of Representatives from the 79th district since 2018. In January 2023, she was appointed Assistant Minority Leader of the Oklahoma House.
